dx_dlbcl_non_gcb.quote: non-germinal-center B-cell-like (non-GCB) by the Hans algorithm

dx_hans_not_abc.note: Lists gene-expression cell-of-origin as untested but never states Hans is only a surrogate for ABC.

dx_not_breast_recurrence.quote: The left axillary biopsy shows no evidence of metastatic breast carcinoma (cytokeratin AE1/AE3 and GATA3 negative in the lesional cells).

stage_spleen_lymphatic.quote: The spleen is a lymphatic organ, so splenic involvement is stage III (IIIS), not stage IV.

mol_del_not_dh.quote: so this is not a double-hit or triple-hit high-grade B-cell lymphoma

cns_no_routine_prophylaxis.quote: I do not recommend intrathecal methotrexate or high-dose IV methotrexate prophylaxis.

tx_cardiac_aware_no_full_dox.quote: I am not using R-CHOP or pola-R-CHP because both contain doxorubicin.

tx_cardio_onc_referral.quote: Before cycle 1: formal cardio-oncology consultation and confirmation of LVEF/GLS

tx_cardioprotection.quote: start an ACE inhibitor or ARB and a beta-blocker for LVEF 45% if not contraindicated

tx_anthracycline_free_curative.quote: Curative-intent anthracycline-free immunochemotherapy: R-CEOP every 21 days for 6 cycles

tx_lower_efficacy_ack.quote: the need for an anthracycline-free regimen adding uncertainty
tx_lower_efficacy_ack.note: Only says anthracycline-free therapy adds uncertainty, not that efficacy is likely lower.

tx_cardiac_monitoring.quote: repeat echocardiography with GLS at the end of therapy
tx_cardiac_monitoring.note: Only end-of-therapy echo; no serial on-treatment imaging or biomarkers.

resp_eot_pet_lugano.quote: whole-body FDG PET-CT about 6-8 weeks after cycle 6, interpreted by Lugano/Deauville criteria

sup_tls_allopurinol.quote: allopurinol 300 mg daily (adjust for renal function) with vigorous hydration starting before cycle 1
sup_tls_allopurinol.note: Gives allopurinol/hydration but does not explicitly grade risk as low-intermediate.

sup_gcsf.quote: pegfilgrastim 6 mg SC on day 2 (or filgrastim) with each cycle

sup_anastrozole.quote: Continue anastrozole 1 mg daily without interruption

work_hbv_reviewed.quote: no HBV antiviral prophylaxis is needed because HBsAg and anti-HBc are negative

fit_curative_ecog1.quote: she is fit for full-dose curative-intent immunochemotherapy

miss_cardiac_workup.quote: Formal cardio-oncology assessment, including a repeat echocardiogram with GLS (or cardiac MRI if there is uncertainty)
miss_cardiac_workup.note: Lists cardio-oncology work-up as missing but not the cause/ischemic evaluation or biomarkers.
